recentItems.title: This Might be the First Good He-Man Game! | gamescom 2026
recentItems.description:
We got hands-on time with He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction, the 90s-inspired beat 'em up from Bitmap Bureau, which has the promise of finally giving us a good He-Man game!

Bitmap Bureau previously made Terminator 2D: No Fate, and their follow-up is equally in service of a loyal fan base, finally giving us a He-Man game that the fans of Masters of the Universe have deserved for years.

We get hands-on time with He-Man himself, playing several levels, including Castle Grayskull, and taking on bosses like Trap Jaw. We also did a full tour of the He-Man gamescom booth, getting a great look at all the retro He-Man toys and, for some reason, He-Man Uno...

Here's How GTA 6's Map Compares to GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Rockstar finally dropped their extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6, and the game looks as dense as any GTA game before it. In fact, according to Rockstar, the map for GTA 6 is twice the size of GTA 5's, and three times the size of Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar North's co-studio head Rob Nelson also revealed that it took him about 80 hours to finish the game while primarily focusing on story missions. In other news, eagle-eyed fans spotted a Red Dead 2 easter egg in the new GTA 6 footage. Plus we’re riding Mine Cart Madness inside Super Nintendo World with The Ride Guys at Universal Epic Universe at Universal Orlando Resort.

Presented by Universal Orlando Resort, and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.

recentItems.title: GTA 6 May Have Multiple Endings, With Jason and Lucia’s Story Influenced By Red Dead Redemption 2
recentItems.description:
During the production of Red Dead Redemption 2, Rockstar put a lot of careful thought into crafting Arthur’s tale, with the aim of ensuring Mr Morgan could both connect with and reflect players better than even John had.  And now, several years later, that same issue has been on Rockstar’s mind while creating GTA 6 protagonists, Jason and Lucia.
